info.title: nulic
info.description: NuGet license disclosure tool — collects and produces a license package for all NuGet dependencies.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Nuget license collection and reporting tool.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: Minimum log level: Verbose, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Fatal. Default: Information.

options.name: --show-defaults
options.description: Print the default nulic.json to stdout and exit. [default: False]

options.name: --merge
options.description: Path to a licenses/ directory from another nulic-processed project to merge into the report. Can be specified multiple times.
